name: sidekick
description: Checks your message before it is sent, by rules and, where worthwhile, briefly with Sonnet: a hint line under your message or a question (new chat with handoff, a skill, a clearer version, or "wrong chat?" when the message belongs to another project). Names due maintenance once per chat (/skill-doctor, prompt-audit, consolidate-memory, /init). /savings shows cost and measurable savings at a glance, /savings detail compares the models over time.
